prompt_parts.label: Global Style
prompt_parts.content:
Global style:
# Megami Translation Style

Translate into natural English visual-novel prose while preserving the source's pacing and character voice.

Core rules:
- Keep Celica's narration in first person.
- Preserve page rhythm; do not merge or split lines during the pilot.
- Use glossary spellings for names, places, menus, and recurring terms.
- Keep English CP932-safe. Prefer ASCII punctuation.
- Use `...` instead of ellipsis characters and straight quotes instead of curly quotes.
- In the default vanilla text profile, never use apostrophes or contractions.
- In the apostrophe-patched text profile, ASCII apostrophes are allowed.
- Never use em dashes, en dashes, curly quotes, or mojibake punctuation.
- Keep each rendered textbox line at or below 50 visible characters.
- The 50-character limit is a hard technical limit. Shorter and plainer is better than overflowing.
- Speaker pages have one speaker line plus up to 3 dialogue lines.
- Narration pages have up to 4 lines.
- Do not translate script labels unless they are proven visible.
- Translate UI/menu text separately from prose.

Model output rules:
- Return JSON only.
- Return translations keyed by `line_id`.
- Do not invent, remove, or rename line IDs.
- Do not translate speaker names creatively; use glossary names.
- Do not include Japanese in English fields unless a term is intentionally left untranslated.
- If a literal translation is too long, compress it while preserving meaning and tone.

prompt_parts.content:
Previous translated blocks in this scene:
{
  "scene_id": "s1:scene:0002",
  "omitted_earlier_translated_blocks": 0,
  "blocks": [
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00514-00524",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "店の女性\nいらっしゃい\n店内に足を踏み入れた俺達を女性の明るい声が出迎える。\n店の女性\n二人ね、そこの席が空いてるわよ\n昼時の為か、ほぼ満員になっている店内を見渡し、\n店の従業員らしいその女性はカウンターに空いた\n二つの席を指し示した。",
      "en": "\"Welcome.\" A cheerful voice from a woman greeted us the moment we stepped inside. \"Two of you? There are seats open over there.\" Looking around the nearly full shop, likely due to lunchtime, the woman, clearly a staff member, pointed to two empty seats at the counter."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00530-00531",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Shuri",
      "jp": "あのすみません、このお店の御店主様は……",
      "en": "Um, excuse me, is the master of this shop..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00537-00539",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "店の女性\n御店主様だなんて呼ばれ方するとくすぐったいけど、\nあたしがそうよ",
      "en": "\"Being called 'Master' makes me feel a bit ticklish, but I'm the one.\""
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00545-00546",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Shuri",
      "jp": "あ、す、すみませんっ",
      "en": "Ah, s-sorry!"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00552-00554",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "女店主\nふふっ、別に謝らなくたっていいわよ\nそれで、あたしに用なの？",
      "en": "\"Heh, no need to apologize, really. So, you need something from me?\""
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00560-00561",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Shuri",
      "jp": "あ、いえ、その、空いているお部屋はありますか？",
      "en": "Oh, um... no, I mean... do you have any rooms available?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00567-00568",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "女店主\n宿の方のお客なんだ、それじゃあカウンターの方に来て",
      "en": "\"So you are here for a room, then. Come to the counter.\""
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00574-00575",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Shuri",
      "jp": "はい",
      "en": "Yes."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00577-00579",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "俺達がカウンターの空いていた席へ来ると、\nカウンターの向こうに回り込んだ女店主が宿帳らしき物を\n引っぱり出して此方に向き直った。",
      "en": "When we arrived at the empty counter seats, the shopkeeper, having circled around behind the counter, pulled out what appeared to be a guest register and turned back to us."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00585-00587",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "女店主\n申し遅れたわね、あたしの名前はリンシャ、\nそれであなた達の名前は？",
      "en": "\"Sorry for not introducing myself sooner. My name is Rinsha. And your names?\""
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00593-00595",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Shuri",
      "jp": "はい、此方はセリカ・シルフィル様、\nそして私が使用人のシュリです",
      "en": "Yes, this is Master Celica Sylphil, and I am his servant, Shuri."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00601-00602",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "使用人？　そう言えばそんな格好しているわね",
      "en": "Servant? Come to think of it, you're dressed the part."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00608-00609",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Shuri",
      "jp": "はい",
      "en": "Yes."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00611-00611",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "サラサラとリンシャが俺達の名前を宿帳に書き込む。",
      "en": "Rinsha writes our names in the register, pen rustling."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00617-00618",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "それで部屋だったわね、空いてるわよ二人部屋？",
      "en": "So, the room... There is one available. A double?"
    }
  ]
}
